target_claim: From each of $S_1,S_k$ we have to choose exactly $n/2$ elements, thus $n$ elements from both sets. By Pigeonhole principle there exists some $x_i$, such that it is chosen from both $S_1,S_k$ thus forming an edge with both $x_1$ and $x_k$.
